title: Cabbage Savoy Gratin
description: A creamy, comforting side dish featuring Savoy cabbage, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, minced garlic, and smoked paprika.
Add sliced cabbage and potatoes to the bowl, and toss to coat.
Transfer the cabbage mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle grated cheese evenly over the top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
